of.needed: which Flux group/kinds were served at the removed v1beta1 and v2beta1 API versions; the evidence names only the version levels, not the affected kinds or groups
whether Flux Operator (controlplaneio-fluxcd/flux-operator) is used to deploy the Flux controllers, in which case the migration is not required

original.statement: In Flux 2.7.0 the deprecated v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs have been removed from the CRDs, and unless the Flux controllers are deployed with Flux Operator, the `flux migrate` command must be run on clusters before upgrading.

exposure.needed: whether the Flux controllers are deployed by Flux Operator (controlplaneio-fluxcd/flux-operator); every cluster not deployed by Flux Operator must run `flux migrate` before upgrading to 2.7.0

corrected.statement: Flux 2.7.0 removes the v1beta1 and v2beta1 Flux APIs from the CRDs. Every cluster whose Flux controllers are not deployed by Flux Operator must run `flux migrate` before upgrading. Exposure depends only on whether Flux Operator deploys the controllers.

decision.reason: [ev-82be76c03b0e] says that unless Flux Operator deploys the Flux controllers, you must run `flux migrate` on clusters before upgrading. The only exemption it gives is Flux Operator. It does not make the migration depend on which kinds or groups a cluster uses at v1beta1/v2beta1. The proposed first condition about affected kinds therefore narrows exposure without support. Exposure turns only on whether Flux Operator deploys the controllers, and the evidence gives no configuration check for that.
